text:
You rush to the door and force it
open. The train is already picking
up speed. Save vs. L5 (add +1 if you
have the Agile Skill, or +2 if you
have it at the Expert level) to land
safely. If you fail, you lose 1 Life
and 1 item of your choice (but not
a cursed item or a Clown mask). If
you pass the roll, you land with
nothing more than a few bruises.
The train zooms away, engulfed in
a cloud of blackness. Probably,
jumping off was a good choice.

zh-CN.title: 14 - 飞驰的火车
text: 你冲到车门前，强行把门打开。火车已经开始加速。进行一次L5防御检定（敏捷技能+1，专家级+2），以安全落地。失败则失去1点生命，并失去你选择的1件物品（诅咒物品和小丑面具除外）。成功则只擦伤几处，平安落地。火车卷入一团黑暗，呼啸而去。跳车看来是个不错的选择。
